SubmittingParty.name: Submitting Party
SubmittingParty.definition: Party that submits the foreign exchange trade to the matching system or to the settlement system or to the counterparty.

TradeParty.name: Trade Party
TradeParty.definition: Party that originated the foreign exchange trade. This party may be the same as the submitting party.

FundIdentification.name: Fund Identification
FundIdentification.definition: Identifies the fund that is one of the parties in the foreign exchange trade.
